The main takeaway from our work is that

consumers are open to the idea of personalised nutrition and nutrigenomics if these developments are communicated to them by trustworthy and credible stakeholders and if the spin-offs of nutrigenomic research provide clear and tangible benefits.
consumers are willing to embrace nutrigenomics, but only if they can see a direct benefit for themselves.
personalised nutrition is not an end in itself, but should be embedded in a larger social context and be perceived to be of value to consumers.
